Yeshanah_Gate@Neh.3.6-.description: The Yeshanah Gate, also known as the Old Gate, one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall rebuilt by Nehemiah (<ref="Neh. 3:6; 12:39">Neh. 3:6; 12:39</ref>).

Yiron@Jos.19.38.description: Yiron, a town in the territory of Naphtali, mentioned in the list of cities allotted to the tribe during the division of the Promised Land (<ref="Josh. 19:38">Josh. 19:38</ref>).
Yiron@Jos.19.38.name: Yiron
